How many bits are in one byte?
What is the binary number 1011 in decimal?

options: The smallest single dot of colour in a digital image

questions.q: How many different values can be stored using 3 bits?
A bit is either 0 or 1.
Images are stored in a computer as a grid of pixels.
The binary number 100 is equal to 100 in decimal.
A kilobyte is bigger than a megabyte.
A single binary digit (0 or 1) is called a ____.
A group of 8 bits is called a ____.
Binary uses only the digits ____ and ____.
Pictures on a screen are made of tiny dots called ____.
Explain why computers use binary.
questions.answer: Computers are made of electronic circuits/switches (1) that have only two states, on and off, which can be represented by 1 and 0 (1).

questions.q: Convert the decimal number 9 into 4-bit binary. Show your working.
Describe how a simple black-and-white picture can be stored using binary.
questions.answer: The picture is split into a grid of pixels (1); each pixel is stored as a single bit, e.g. 0 for white and 1 for black (1).
